object.attr: Export is how a user backs up their data from a local-only app. The user chooses the location, so no storage permission is needed. Preferences are not part of the backup. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: When the user selects the export row on the Settings screen, the app shall write the saved workouts to one ZIP archive at a location the user chooses.
